description: Maya is the keeper of the family's community-garden plot and must finalize what goes in each bed, when planting happens, how watering will work, and how part of the harvest will be used, with input from three relatives.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: Garden Plot Keeper and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: The family has one community-garden plot divided into three equal beds.
shared_context.S2: The garden committee allows the family to grow food and flowers but asks each plot holder to keep a simple care plan.
shared_context.S3: Maya keeps the plot key and is responsible for submitting the family's final planting and care plan.
shared_context.S4: At the family's garden check-in, Maya goes around the group and asks each person whether anything about the plants, timing, watering, or harvest use should shape the plan before she submits it.
shared_context.S5: The family wants the plot to provide vegetables for home meals, support pollinators, and set aside some produce for a community use.

PF1.text: The coordinator of Tessa's neighborhood cooking class asked her for exactly 6 kilograms of cucumbers from the family plot for the class on August 22, 2027, and Tessa agreed that the family would try to provide them; this has not reached the group yet.

PF2.text: Luis reserved exactly two strawberry plants through the community seed exchange, which requires them to be collected and planted in bed 1 on May 10, 2027; the exchange message has not been shared with the family.

PF3.text: The garden committee's recent sunlight note says bed 3 receives direct sun only in the morning, so the committee recommended kale there and watering on Tuesday and Saturday mornings; Noor has not shown the note to the group.

acceptance_conditions: Bed 1 must be planted with the two reserved strawberry plants.
Bed 2 must be planted with cucumbers.
Bed 3 must be planted with kale.
The planting date must be May 10, 2027.
Exactly 6 kilograms of cucumbers must be allocated to the neighborhood cooking class.
The watering plan must specify Tuesday and Saturday mornings.
A commitment to deliver 6 kilograms of cucumbers to the cooking class must be recorded.
A commitment to collect and plant the reserved strawberry plants in bed 1 must be recorded.
A commitment to follow the committee's bed 3 shade and watering recommendation must be recorded.
The final justification must cite the committee's sunlight recommendation after Noor has spoken.

decisive_facts.why: The cooking class's exact request changes bed 2 to cucumbers, sets the allocation to exactly 6 kilograms, and creates the required delivery commitment.
The seed exchange reservation changes bed 1 to strawberries, fixes planting to May 10, 2027, and requires the collection-and-planting commitment.
The committee's sunlight note changes bed 3 to kale, fixes watering to Tuesday and Saturday mornings, and requires the shade-and-watering commitment and citation.
